newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Energy's topper turnaround to start April 11.
newsitem.headline: Japan Energy's topper turnaround to start April 11.

text.p: Japan Energy Corp said on Wednesday it planned to close its 90,200 barrel-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit at its Mizushima plant from April 11 to end-May for maintenance work.
The turnaround schedule of secondary refining facilities, and details on the capacity of the secondary units to be effected by the maintenance work, were not disclosed.

Japan Energy's other toppers -- a 110,000 bpd topper also at the Mizushima plant and a 95,000 bpd topper at its Chita refinery -- were closed for maintenance checks last year and will operate normally throughout this year.
Japanese refineries usually undergo major turnaround periods every other year.
